We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts: a person (闵某) was a director (主任) of a public apartment (公寓) and also of a housing construction life segment. He used his position to embezzle public funds: 64,000 yuan via setting up bonus distribution schemes with others, personally got 25,500. Also from Dec 2012 to June 2014, he used his position to procure materials and used false invoices to defraud public funds 15,350 yuan. Total embezzlement 79,350 yuan, personally got 40,850. The prosecution says he is main participant, principal, in a joint embezzlement crime.

Thus the crime is 贪污罪 (embezzlement). Since he is a public employee (state staff) - he is a public servant? He is a director of a public apartment, likely a state-owned enterprise? The examples: For non-state staff receiving bribes, they used "非国家工作人员受贿". For embezzlement, there is "贪污罪". If the person is a public employee, it's "贪污罪". If not a state employee, maybe "非法占有公款罪"? But typical Chinese criminal law: 贪污罪 applies to state functionaries who misappropriate public funds. The facts say "公寓" maybe a public housing? Likely a state-owned property management. So "贪污罪". Also there is "挪用公款" for misusing public funds but not embezzlement. Here they directly stole from public funds, so 贪污.

Thus answer: [罪名]贪污<eoa>.

Check examples: For similar case of embezzlement, they used "受贿;滥用职权". For embezzlement they used "挪用公款". But that was about a school cashier misusing funds, they used "挪用公款". In this case, it's direct theft from public funds, not borrowing. So "贪污". Also there is "共同贪污" maybe "共同贪污". But typical answer is just "贪污". The format: [罪名]贪污<eoa>.
